$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this file.

setup.description: Setup options: controls VS Code + ChromeDriver download and extension packaging/installation.

vscodeVersion.description: Version of VS Code to test against. Accepts 'latest', 'min', 'max', or a specific version string (e.g. '1.131.0').

type.description: Type of VS Code release stream.

storage.description: Folder used for all test resources (VS Code binary, ChromeDriver, logs). Defaults to $TEST_RESOURCES or $TMPDIR/test-resources.

packageOptions.description: vsce packaging options forwarded directly to vsce.createVSIX(). Mirrors @vscode/vsce IPackageOptions — any field vsce supports is accepted, even if not listed here.

packagePath.description: Destination path of the packaged .vsix file (vsce: --out). Defaults to <name>-<version>.vsix in the extension directory.

version.description: Bump the extension to this version before packaging (equivalent to 'vsce package <version>').

target.description: Target platform for a platform-specific extension (vsce: --target).

ignoreOtherTargetFolders.description: Ignore files inside folders named after other targets (vsce: --ignore-other-target-folders). Only valid when 'target' is set.

followSymlinks.description: Recurse into symlinked directories instead of treating them as files (vsce: --follow-symlinks).

commitMessage.description: Commit message used when calling 'npm version' (vsce: --message). Only applies when 'version' is set.

gitTagVersion.description: Create a version commit and tag when calling 'npm version'. Set to false for vsce --no-git-tag-version. Only applies when 'version' is set.

updatePackageJson.description: Update package.json when bumping the version. Set to false for vsce --no-update-package-json. Only applies when 'version' is set.

cwd.description: Directory of the extension to package. Defaults to the current working directory.

readmePath.description: Path to the README file shown on the marketplace (vsce: --readme-path). Defaults to README.md.

changelogPath.description: Path to the CHANGELOG file (vsce: --changelog-path). Defaults to CHANGELOG.md.

githubBranch.description: GitHub branch used to infer relative links in README.md (vsce: --githubBranch). Can be overridden by baseContentUrl and baseImagesUrl.

gitlabBranch.description: GitLab branch used to infer relative links in README.md (vsce: --gitlabBranch). Can be overridden by baseContentUrl and baseImagesUrl.

rewriteRelativeLinks.description: Rewrite relative links in README.md into absolute URLs. Set to false for vsce --no-rewrite-relative-links.

baseContentUrl.description: Prepend all relative links in README.md with this URL (vsce: --baseContentUrl).

baseImagesUrl.description: Prepend all relative image links in README.md with this URL (vsce: --baseImagesUrl).

useYarn.description: Use yarn instead of npm when packaging (vsce: --yarn / --no-yarn). When not set, vsce infers it from the presence of yarn.lock or .yarnrc.

dependencyEntryPoints.description: Select packages that should be included when packaging (vsce: --packagedDependencies).

gitHubIssueLinking.description: Automatically expand GitHub-style issue syntax (#123) into links in README.md. Set to false for vsce --no-gitHubIssueLinking.

gitLabIssueLinking.description: Automatically expand GitLab-style issue syntax into links in README.md. Set to false for vsce --no-gitLabIssueLinking.

dependencies.description: Detect and include npm/yarn dependencies in the package. Set to false for the vsce --no-dependencies flag — typically needed together with useYarn, for yarn/npm workspaces, or when the extension is fully bundled.

preRelease.description: Mark the packaged extension as a pre-release (vsce: --pre-release).

allowStarActivation.description: Allow the use of * in activationEvents (vsce: --allow-star-activation).

allowMissingRepository.description: Skip the check for a repository field in package.json (vsce: --allow-missing-repository).

allowUnusedFilesPattern.description: Allow 'files' patterns in package.json that match no files (vsce: --allow-unused-files-pattern).

allowPackageSecrets.description: Allow packaging specific kinds of detected secrets (vsce: --allow-package-secrets). Secret names are reported in the packaging error message.

allowPackageAllSecrets.description: Allow packaging even when secrets are detected (vsce: --allow-package-all-secrets).

skipLicense.description: Skip adding a LICENSE file to the package (vsce: --skip-license).

signTool.description: Path to a VSIX signing tool (vsce: --sign-tool). Invoked with the signature manifest and .p7s file as arguments.

installDependencies.description: Automatically install extensions your extension depends on from the marketplace.

noCache.description: Skip using a cached download and fetch a fresh copy.

run.description: Run options: controls test execution inside VS Code.

testFiles.description: Glob pattern(s) for test files to run. Used as CLI positional arguments when none are provided on the command line.

vscodeVersion.description: Version of VS Code to test against. Accepts 'latest', 'min', 'max', or a specific version string (e.g. '1.131.0').

type.description: Type of VS Code release stream.

storage.description: Folder used for all test resources. Defaults to $TEST_RESOURCES or $TMPDIR/test-resources.

settings.description: Path to a custom VS Code settings.json file to apply during the test run.

cleanup.description: Uninstall the extension under test after the test run completes.

mochaConfig.description: Path to a Mocha configuration file.

offline.description: Run without an internet connection. All required resources must be pre-downloaded.

resources.description: File or folder paths to open in VS Code at startup.

customPageObjects.description: Path to a compiled JS locator contribution file for custom page objects.

locale.description: Display language locale for VS Code (e.g. 'ru', 'zh-cn', 'fr'). Requires the matching language pack extension to be installed.
